why: The shaft's hatch in the near hall's floor built of iron bars instead of a closed iron trapdoor. Bars laid flat are posts two sixteenths wide, joined by the server with arms two sixteenths wide, and a player-wide body drops between them; the walk model reads a floor from the blocks' collision footprints, never from whether the cells hold a block. So the hatch is no floor: a body stepping onto it falls into the undercroft while the hatch is shut, and `DW1011` names that fall as a way past it. It declares no unit: the surface is the bar's block, and what must not compile is a shut floor a body falls through.
